summary: Linjemontage i Grästorp Aktiebolag (publ) operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) provider that focuses on delivering power infrastructure projects and power supply solutions and services in Sweden, Norway, and Croatia. The company offers power infrastructure, such as substations, transmission and distribution networks, and system operators, as well as designs and build power plants. Linjemontage i Grästorp Aktiebolag (publ) was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Grastorp, Sweden. Linjemontage i Grästorp Aktiebolag (publ) operates as a subsidiary of Kalpataru Power Transmission Sweden AB.
